# Mahdev (Pvt) Ltd

> Mahdev is a Sri Lankan company bringing together event production, photography and cinema, technology, travel, and online retail.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/): Overview of Mahdev and its divisions.
- [About Mahdev](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/about): Company background and information.
- [Services](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/services): Services available across Mahdev.
- [Projects](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/portfolio): Selected projects and work.
- [Gallery](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/gallery): Photography and visual work.
- [Careers](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/careers): Current job openings in Trincomalee and Colombo, Sri Lanka, with online applications.
- [Contact](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/contact): Contact and enquiry information.
- [Insights](https://mahdev-official.vercel.app/insights): Company articles and insights.

## Divisions

- [SWS Event Management](https://sws-events.vercel.app): SWS Events, an event planner in Trincomalee for wedding, birthday, cultural ceremony and corporate event decoration in Trincomalee, Colombo and nearby areas.
- [U1 Studio](https://u1-studio.vercel.app): Wedding photographers in Trincomalee and Colombo; pre-shoots, event, portrait and product photography, 4K films and albums.
- [Mahdev IT](https://mahdev-it.vercel.app): IT and digital solutions.
- [Mahdev Travels](https://mahdev-travels.vercel.app): Travel planning and experiences.
- [Mahdev Online Mart](https://mahdev-mart.vercel.app): Online retail and equipment.

Each public host publishes its own host-scoped `/sitemap.xml` and `/robots.txt`.

## SWS Event Management

- Official name: SWS Event Management
- Website: https://sws-events.vercel.app
- Trincomalee address: No 95/15, Iluppaikkulam, Kanniya Road, Trincomalee 31006
- Colombo address: 41/22, Pickerings Road, Kotahena, Colombo 13
- Phone / WhatsApp: +94750928078
- Service area: Trincomalee, Nilaveli, Uppuveli, Colombo and Sri Lanka.
- Services: wedding decoration, birthday decoration, cradle and naming ceremony decoration, puberty ceremony decoration, engagement and homecoming decoration, corporate event planning, stage decoration and event rentals.
